consent_decisions_target_check.name: consent_decisions_target_check
consent_decisions_target_check.value: ("consent_decisions"."decision" = 'accepted' AND "consent_decisions"."target_acceptance_decision_id" IS NULL) OR ("consent_decisions"."decision" = 'withdrawn' AND "consent_decisions"."target_acceptance_decision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_decisions"."document_key" IS NULL AND "consent_decisions"."document_revision" IS NULL)

consent_decisions_acceptance_evidence_ch.name: consent_decisions_acceptance_evidence_check
consent_decisions_acceptance_evidence_ch.value: "consent_decisions"."decision" <> 'accepted' OR "consent_decisions"."decision_source" = 'legacy_backfill' OR ("consent_decisions"."document_key" IS NOT NULL AND "consent_decisions"."document_revision" IS NOT NULL)

consents_status_timestamps_check.name: consents_status_timestamps_check
consents_status_timestamps_check.value: ("consents"."status" = 'accepted' AND "consents"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL) OR ("consents"."status" = 'withdrawn' AND "consents"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL)

conversations_saved_expiry_check.name: conversations_saved_expiry_check
conversations_saved_expiry_check.value: ("conversations"."is_saved" = true AND "conversations"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("conversations"."is_saved" = false AND "conversations"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

human_review_queue_state_timestamps_chec.name: human_review_queue_state_timestamps_check
human_review_queue_state_timestamps_chec.value: ("human_review_queue_items"."state" = 'pending' AND "human_review_queue_items"."started_at" IS NULL AND "human_review_queue_items"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "human_review_queue_items"."resolution_code" IS NULL) OR ("human_review_queue_items"."state" = 'in_review' AND "human_review_queue_items"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "human_review_queue_items"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "human_review_queue_items"."resolution_code" IS NULL) OR ("human_review_queue_items"."state" = 'resolved' AND "human_review_queue_items"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "human_review_queue_items"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "human_review_queue_items"."resolution_code" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_article_versions_status_timest.name: knowledge_article_versions_status_timestamps_check
knowledge_article_versions_status_timest.value: ("knowledge_article_versions"."publication_status" = 'draft' AND "knowledge_article_versions"."published_at" IS NULL AND "knowledge_article_versions"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL) OR ("knowledge_article_versions"."publication_status" = 'published' AND "knowledge_article_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_article_versions"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL) OR ("knowledge_article_versions"."publication_status" = 'withdrawn' AND "knowledge_article_versions"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL AND (("knowledge_article_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_article_versions"."withdrawn_at" >= "knowledge_article_versions"."published_at") OR ("knowledge_article_versions"."published_at" IS NULL AND "knowledge_article_versions"."content_origin" = 'curated' AND "knowledge_article_versions"."review_status" = 'source_verified')))

knowledge_article_versions_review_eviden.name: knowledge_article_versions_review_evidence_check
knowledge_article_versions_review_eviden.value: ("knowledge_article_versions"."review_status" = 'unverified' AND "knowledge_article_versions"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "knowledge_article_versions"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("knowledge_article_versions"."review_status" IN ('source_verified', 'professional_reviewed') AND "knowledge_article_versions"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_article_versions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

risk_events_incognito_refs_check.name: risk_events_incognito_refs_check
risk_events_incognito_refs_check.value: "risk_events"."is_incognito" = false OR ("risk_events"."conversation_id" IS NULL AND "risk_events"."ai_turn_id" IS NULL AND "risk_events"."trigger_message_id" IS NULL)

staff_principals_status_timestamp_check.name: staff_principals_status_timestamp_check
staff_principals_status_timestamp_check.value: ("staff_principals"."status" = 'active' AND "staff_principals"."disabled_at" IS NULL) OR ("staff_principals"."status" = 'disabled' AND "staff_principals"."disabled_at" IS NOT NULL)

staff_role_grants_revocation_check.name: staff_role_grants_revocation_check
staff_role_grants_revocation_check.value: ("staff_role_grants"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "staff_role_grants"."revoked_by_principal_id" IS NULL) OR "staff_role_grants"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
